brief: marketing landing page for an API observability tool

defects.what: The main task (book a demo) is a quiet secondary button; the only filled primary just scrolls the page
A dark code snippet dominates the fold; the product itself is below it
On phone the main conversion action is hidden inside the collapsed menu
'Book a demo' leads to downloading a text file; label, heading and outcome disagree
Required and optional fields look the same; small labels; browser-default errors only
Copy only selects text; the toast is far from the button and confirms nothing
A loud lime selection colour used nowhere else, hard to read on the snippet
11-12px chart and trace labels in muted colour, hard to read in dark mode; hero letters nearly touch
Dropdown hides three in-page anchors and mixes navigation levels
Large empty heading column; faint toggle far from the question
Pricing repeats prices and labels like 'View quickstart' do not say what happens
Invented, unattributed testimonials take a full section
The strongest call to action is in pricing, not in the hero

reviewer: Claude Sonnet, blind review of screenshots and source (never saw the rule list)
